title: Check every tag outside the generator
statement: Check each grade and standard tag outside the generator, against the delivered text and the skill it tests.
example: Told to write for grade 5, generating agents produced 17 of 20 items at grade 3 standards.
detail: Agents told to write for grade 5 produced 17 of 20 items at grade 3 standards, a pull toward their usual grade, so the reading project's account of what its generator can't do for itself puts an external grade-band and standards check in the gate, rejecting off-band tags (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/LLM_GENERATION_BOUNDARY.md`). A genre-aware audit of 26 items' standard tags made four corrections, one of them a literary tag on a purely informational passage, and left four borderline items flagged, not flipped, to avoid a confident wrong guess (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/v2_final_package/docs/COURSE_QUALITY_GATE_REPORT.md`). A standards backfill for a grade 5 unit tagged an item only where the live passage still matched the tested one, 558 of 600, and left the 42 whose passage had been swapped uncoded, since coding them from the stale snapshot would be fabrication (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/SUMMARY_AGENT_G5.qmd`). Leave an item untagged where the delivered text no longer matches its source.
